queries.name: exact_existing_product_key_coverage
queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT unidad_negocio_id,server_id,producto_codigo_fuente,COUNT_BIG(*) AS filas,SUM(importe_neto) AS neto FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id IN ('CIENFUEGOS','ORIGEN') AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15' AND activo=1 AND cancelado_origen=0 AND es_kpi_valido=1 GROUP BY unidad_negocio_id,server_id,producto_codigo_fuente) SELECT d.unidad_negocio_id,COUNT_BIG(*) AS codigos_distintos,SUM(d.filas) AS filas_totales,SUM(CASE WHEN m.coincidencias=1 THEN d.filas ELSE 0 END) AS filas_clave_exacta_unica,SUM(CASE WHEN m.coincidencias=0 THEN d.filas ELSE 0 END) AS filas_sin_clave_exacta,SUM(CASE WHEN m.coincidencias>1 THEN d.filas ELSE 0 END) AS filas_clave_ambigua,SUM(CASE WHEN m.coincidencias=1 AND m.clasificacion IS NOT NULL THEN d.filas ELSE 0 END) AS filas_clasificadas_por_clave,SUM(CASE WHEN m.coincidencias=1 THEN d.neto ELSE 0 END) AS neto_clave_unica FROM d OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias,MIN(ClasificacionProductoID) AS clasificacion FROM dbo.Sync_Productos p WHERE p.ServerID=TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,d.server_id) AND p.CodigoFuente=d.producto_codigo_fuente) m GROUP BY d.unidad_negocio_id ORDER BY d.unidad_negocio_id

queries.name: cancelled_ticket_original_headers
queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT unidad_negocio_id,sistema_origen,server_id,sucursal_id,fecha_operacion,id_transaccion,numero_ticket,folio_origen,COUNT_BIG(*) AS filas,COUNT_BIG(ticket_total) AS filas_header,COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_total) AS valores_header,MAX(ticket_total) AS total_header,SUM(importe_neto) AS neto_detalle FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id IN ('CIENFUEGOS','ORIGEN') AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15' AND activo=1 AND cancelado_origen=1 GROUP BY unidad_negocio_id,sistema_origen,server_id,sucursal_id,fecha_operacion,id_transaccion,numero_ticket,folio_origen) SELECT unidad_negocio_id,sistema_origen,COUNT_BIG(*) AS tickets_cancelados,SUM(filas) AS filas,SUM(CASE WHEN valores_header=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_header_consistente,SUM(CASE WHEN valores_header>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_header_conflictivo,SUM(CASE WHEN filas_header=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_sin_header,SUM(CASE WHEN valores_header=1 AND total_header>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_header_positivo,SUM(CASE WHEN valores_header=1 THEN total_header ELSE NULL END) AS monto_header_cancelado,SUM(neto_detalle) AS neto_detalle_cancelado FROM t GROUP BY unidad_negocio_id,sistema_origen ORDER BY unidad_negocio_id

queries.name: zero_quantity_or_negative_discount_diagnostic
queries.sql: SELECT unidad_negocio_id,producto_codigo_fuente,COUNT_BIG(*) AS filas,MIN(cantidad) AS cantidad_minima,MAX(cantidad) AS cantidad_maxima,SUM(importe_bruto) AS bruto,SUM(importe_neto) AS neto,SUM(descuento) AS descuento,MIN(descuento_pct) AS porcentaje_minimo,MAX(descuento_pct) AS porcentaje_maximo FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id IN ('CIENFUEGOS','ORIGEN') AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15' AND activo=1 AND cancelado_origen=0 AND es_kpi_valido=1 AND (cantidad=0 OR descuento<0) GROUP BY unidad_negocio_id,producto_codigo_fuente ORDER BY unidad_negocio_id,producto_codigo_fuente

queries.name: snapshot_retention_dates_only
queries.sql: SELECT unidad_negocio_id,CONVERT(char(7),fecha_operacion,120) AS periodo,COUNT_BIG(*) AS snapshots,COUNT(DISTINCT fecha_operacion) AS fechas,MIN(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_minima,MAX(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_maxima,COUNT_BIG(detalle_abiertas_json) AS snapshots_con_json_no_nulo FROM dbo.Comercial_Ventas_Dia_Abiertas_v2 WHERE unidad_negocio_id IN ('CIENFUEGOS','ORIGEN') AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-21' GROUP BY unidad_negocio_id,CONVERT(char(7),fecha_operacion,120) ORDER BY unidad_negocio_id,periodo

queries.name: alternate_discount_columns_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT sc.name AS esquema,t.name AS tabla,c.name AS columna,ty.name AS tipo FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas sc ON sc.schema_id=t.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE sc.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Comercial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE 'Sync[_]%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cheque%') AND (c.name LIKE '%descu%' OR c.name LIKE '%bonif%' OR c.name LIKE '%cancel%') ORDER BY t.name,c.name
